core_claim: TV drama did get measurably better between 1990 and 2018, but the gain hides in the top of the distribution — the prestige tier (seasons rated 9.0+) multiplied roughly tenfold while average ratings barely moved.

edt_01.label: Hook — the flat-mean trap
edt_01.title: The flat-mean trap
edt_01.editorial_notes: Open by stating the small mean gain (7.94 → 8.08) so the reader sees the contrarian setup before the payoff. Numbers must be exact.

edt_02.label: The prestige tier exploded
edt_02.title: The prestige tier exploded
edt_02.editorial_notes: ana_04 carries the lead claim of the piece. The 2014 = 13, 2017 = 16 season counts must be exact. Cross-link to ana_05 to anchor in 'Peak TV' growth.

edt_03.label: What the top of the chart actually looks like
edt_03.title: What the top of the chart looks like
edt_03.editorial_notes: Use ana_06 for the top-20 visual. Be careful to discuss low-vote-share entries (Parenthood S1, Touched by an Angel S5) so readers see why share matters.

edt_04.label: The within-show arc — sticking the landing
edt_04.title: Sticking the landing
edt_04.editorial_notes: Lead with the population curve (ana_09: peak at season 5), then narrate Breaking Bad and Game of Thrones from ana_07. Highlight True Detective as the counter-example.

edt_05.label: Risers and fallers — where the arguments live
edt_05.title: Risers and fallers
edt_05.editorial_notes: These are the shows readers will recognize and argue about. The interactive flag suggests a side-by-side or sortable element with the top risers and fallers.

edt_06.label: Genre — where the rise lives
edt_06.title: Where the rise lives, by genre
edt_06.editorial_notes: Show the per-genre delta as a sorted bar chart. Sci-Fi (-0.16) and Thriller (-0.29) must be visible — they undercut the simple 'everything got better' story.

edt_07.label: Caveats that survive the headline
edt_07.title: What the algorithm hides
edt_07.editorial_notes: Close with caveat and reframe: not 'rising tide', but 'denser top'. End on the fact that the headline survives the caveats — through 2018.
